name: world-time
description: This revision's memory behavior, written before an engine implements it (Specification Status: a case may enter marked pending_engine; the release requires every case verified). Temporal succession (§25.4): a world change is one Assertion, the old value answers for its time, nothing is superseded; a claim with no stated start is indeterminate before it was made (§25.2); time bounds are three-valued (§25.5); functional_by partitions preferences by option kind (§20.15); kip:memory-default decides by context specificity, first-person testimony and recency, and discloses the rule (§21.13); two inferences without a written start never succeed one another; DEFINE adds to the draft vocabulary (§20.16); the Search Pattern is bounded and never inside NOT (§43.8).

ColorScheme.description: A color scheme: one kind of preference option.

Editor.description: An editor: another kind of preference option.

lives_in.description: Primary residence; one at a time.

located_in.description: The smaller place lies within the larger.

timezone.description: Current timezone as a UTC offset string.

cases.name: a world change is one Assertion: the new value holds from its start
cases.command: FIND(?b.status) WHERE { ?s CONCEPT {name: "Alice"} ?o CONCEPT {name: "Shanghai"} ?b BELIEF (?s, "lives_in", ?o) } FOR TIME "2026-09-20T00:00:00.000Z"

cases.name: the succeeded value is outside its effective interval after the change
cases.command: FIND(?b.status) WHERE { ?s CONCEPT {name: "Alice"} ?o CONCEPT {name: "Beijing"} ?b BELIEF (?s, "lives_in", ?o) } FOR TIME "2026-09-20T00:00:00.000Z"

cases.name: the succeeded value still answers for its time
cases.command: FIND(?b.status) WHERE { ?s CONCEPT {name: "Alice"} ?o CONCEPT {name: "Beijing"} ?b BELIEF (?s, "lives_in", ?o) } FOR TIME "2026-06-01T00:00:00.000Z"

cases.name: and the successor is not yet valid then
cases.command: FIND(?b.status) WHERE { ?s CONCEPT {name: "Alice"} ?o CONCEPT {name: "Shanghai"} ?b BELIEF (?s, "lives_in", ?o) } FOR TIME "2026-06-01T00:00:00.000Z"

cases.name: nothing was superseded or retracted
cases.command: FIND(?a.lifecycle.status) WHERE { ?s CONCEPT {name: "Alice"} ?o CONCEPT {name: "Beijing"} ?p PROPOSITION (?s, "lives_in", ?o) ?a ASSERTION {proposition: ?p} }

cases.name: a claim with no stated start is indeterminate before it was made
cases.command: FIND(?b.status, ?b.uncertainty.reasons) WHERE { ?s CONCEPT {name: "Alice"} ?o CONCEPT {name: "Beijing"} ?b BELIEF (?s, "lives_in", ?o) } FOR TIME "2026-01-05T00:00:00.000Z"

cases.name: a coarse start is indeterminate inside its range
cases.command: FIND(?b.status) WHERE { ?s CONCEPT {name: "Carol"} ?o CONCEPT {name: "Berlin"} ?b BELIEF (?s, "lives_in", ?o) } FOR TIME "2026-06-01T00:00:00.000Z"

cases.name: and certain after it
cases.command: FIND(?b.status) WHERE { ?s CONCEPT {name: "Carol"} ?o CONCEPT {name: "Berlin"} ?b BELIEF (?s, "lives_in", ?o) } FOR TIME "2027-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"

cases.name: functional_by: the newer preference of one kind succeeds the older
cases.command: FIND(?b.status) WHERE { ?s CONCEPT {name: "Alice"} ?o CONCEPT {name: "Dark"} ?b BELIEF (?s, "prefers", ?o) } FOR TIME "2026-09-20T00:00:00.000Z"

cases.name: the newer preference is accepted
cases.command: FIND(?b.status) WHERE { ?s CONCEPT {name: "Alice"} ?o CONCEPT {name: "Light"} ?b BELIEF (?s, "prefers", ?o) } FOR TIME "2026-09-20T00:00:00.000Z"

cases.name: a preference of another kind coexists
cases.command: FIND(?b.status) WHERE { ?s CONCEPT {name: "Alice"} ?o CONCEPT {name: "Vim"} ?b BELIEF (?s, "prefers", ?o) } FOR TIME "2026-09-20T00:00:00.000Z"

cases.name: memory-default: the subject's own statement outranks hearsay
cases.command: FIND(?b.status) WHERE { ?s CONCEPT {name: "Alice"} ?b BELIEF (?s, "timezone", "+08:00") } FOR TIME "2026-09-20T00:00:00.000Z" WITH EPISTEMIC {policy: "kip:memory-default"}

cases.name: the outranked hearsay is uncertain and names the rule
cases.command: FIND(?b.status, ?b.uncertainty.reasons, ?b.precedence.rule) WHERE { ?s CONCEPT {name: "Alice"} ?b BELIEF (?s, "timezone", "+09:00") } FOR TIME "2026-09-20T00:00:00.000Z" WITH EPISTEMIC {policy: "kip:memory-default"}

cases.name: memory-default: a newer observation prevails over older testimony by recency
cases.command: FIND(?b.status) WHERE { ?s CONCEPT {name: "Dave"} ?b BELIEF (?s, "timezone", "+02:00") } FOR TIME "2026-09-20T00:00:00.000Z" WITH EPISTEMIC {policy: "kip:memory-default"}

cases.name: the older testimony is outranked by recency, never rejected
cases.command: FIND(?b.status, ?b.uncertainty.reasons, ?b.precedence.rule) WHERE { ?s CONCEPT {name: "Dave"} ?b BELIEF (?s, "timezone", "+01:00") } FOR TIME "2026-09-20T00:00:00.000Z" WITH EPISTEMIC {policy: "kip:memory-default"}

cases.name: two inferences never succeed one another: the older is still eligible and outranked, not expired
cases.command: FIND(?b.status, ?b.uncertainty.reasons, ?b.precedence.rule) WHERE { ?s CONCEPT {name: "Acme campus"} ?o CONCEPT {name: "Austin"} ?b BELIEF (?s, "located_in", ?o) } FOR TIME "2026-09-20T00:00:00.000Z" WITH EPISTEMIC {policy: "kip:memory-default"}

cases.name: the newer inference prevails by recency, not by an invented world change
cases.command: FIND(?b.status) WHERE { ?s CONCEPT {name: "Acme campus"} ?o CONCEPT {name: "Dallas"} ?b BELIEF (?s, "located_in", ?o) } FOR TIME "2026-09-20T00:00:00.000Z" WITH EPISTEMIC {policy: "kip:memory-default"}

cases.name: DEFINE adds a Predicate to the draft vocabulary
the draft symbol resolves for the next operation
cases.command: FIND(?p) WHERE { ?p (?x, "mentors", ?y) }

cases.name: a name that already resolves fails SchemaSymbolConflict
a draft Predicate cannot claim a closed world
a Search Pattern binds hits with a bounded candidate set
cases.command: FIND(?x.name) WHERE { ?x SEARCH CONCEPT "Alice" WITH TYPE "Person" MODE "keyword" LIMIT 5 }

cases.name: a Search Pattern requires LIMIT
cases.command: FIND(?x) WHERE { ?x SEARCH CONCEPT "Alice" }

cases.name: a Search Pattern never proves absence
cases.command: FIND(?x) WHERE { ?x CONCEPT {name: "Alice"} NOT { ?y SEARCH CONCEPT "Bob" LIMIT 5 } }
